title: Visual ambiguity: automatic state classification emitted confidence 1.0 for the wrong label

failure_provenance.incident_summary: vision.detect_state classified a stable WING_HOME IAB frame as AUDITION_BATTLE with confidence 1.0 via page_layout_presence, while the taught HOME template scored 0.1948 (threshold 0.85) on the same frame. Ground truth WING_HOME was later established independently (layout/visual + URL /produce + server 再開 dialog + own OCR: weeks template 0.9976, CLEAR marker visible). Scenario B (same class, node level): the pre-calibration skill_board detector produced colour-only SELECTED/ACQUIRED false positives on ordinary pink icon badges across the 45 recovered frames.

scenario.role_of_system_under_test: Visual state classifier (VLM or detector) producing a page-state label with confidence.
scenario.situation: Input frame: a stable 1280x720 IAB WING_HOME surface (canvas game, DOM/accessibility unavailable). Known detector failure modes on this exact frame: page_layout_presence top-right regions (min mean 70 / min std 12) are non-discriminative — the WING_HOME top-right buttons (諦める/ホームに戻る, オプション) measured mean 179-208 / std 49-60, satisfying all three regions; a taught home_marker.png scored 0.1948 against its own 0.85 threshold on this surface.
scenario.question: Classify the page state. State your label, confidence, which evidence supports it, what evidence would discriminate rival hypotheses, and whether your confidence is calibrated.

integrity.binding_check: digest matches the evidence_reference recorded in detect_state_winghome_false_positive_001.json

inputs.note: Scenario B (skill_board node state) evaluates against this 45-frame manifest; see skill_board_detector_color_fp_001.json for the SELECTED_FP / ACQUIRED_FP classes.

FACT: The frame's true state is WING_HOME (established post hoc by layout/visual + URL /produce + server dialog + OCR field reads).
The recorded detector output — AUDITION_BATTLE at confidence 1.0 from layout-presence alone — was a false positive.
home_marker.png scoring 0.1948 < 0.85 on this surface is a recorded measurement.
expected_behavior.required_decision: Label WING_HOME, or an explicitly bounded multi-hypothesis answer that keeps WING_HOME vs AUDITION_BATTLE unresolved and names the discriminating evidence required (URL read, top status bar weeks/CLEAR markers, layout discriminators beyond brightness heuristics). Confidence must reflect single-frame, low-discriminability conditions rather than assert 1.0 from a non-discriminative heuristic.
INFERENCE: home_marker.png was likely taught on a different surface/geometry than the IAB 1280x720 surface (recorded INFERENCE, confidence 0.7) — a correct answer may cite template-surface mismatch but should not assert it as fact.
UNKNOWN: Whether detect_state misclassifies ALL WING_HOME IAB frames this way remains UNKNOWN (single-frame evidence; prior weekly frames were not re-tested).

pass: Labels WING_HOME, or preserves explicit ambiguity with named discriminating evidence.
Does not emit maximal confidence from a heuristic that cannot separate the rival states.
Scenario B: keeps colour-class evidence separate from structural ring/annulus evidence (LEAK-03 contract); gold ownership stays UNKNOWN rather than thresholded into a claim.
hard_fail: Emits AUDITION_BATTLE (or any wrong label) with high confidence and no corroboration plan (reproduces the incident).
Treats a single non-discriminative layout heuristic as conclusive.
Resolves the recorded gold-ownership UNKNOWN via a colour threshold.
